cost_model.calibration: No timings from real operators exist yet. Desktop and the console record when a request was raised and when it was answered, but every answer on record was given by a script, so those gaps measure the harness, not a person. Until Desktop has real operator telemetry, the per-touch numbers below are assumptions: keystroke-level estimates for reading a card and clicking (approval), plus looking a record up in the app (stop, reconcile), and a typed-entry estimate for a 12-field registration form (manual entry: about 120 characters at 40 words a minute, plus reading the referral and the duplicate search). The interrupt charge is the resumption lag reported in interruption studies (tens of seconds).

describe.readback: pipelined, window 1; the harness waits for each check
describe.repair: self-repair on a halt before any effect (rule-based agent, no model)
